question:
Six people P, Q, R, S, T and U live on six different floors of the same building. The bottom-most floor of the building is numbered as 1; the floor above it is numbered as 2 and so on. The topmost floor is numbered as 6.

P lives on an even-numbered floor but not on floor number 4. Only two people live between S and P. R lives immediately below T. U lives on an even-numbered floor. Q does not live on the bottom-most floor. How many people live between Q and S?
